name: 大三巴牌坊

origin.note: 21.6 m south of the middle of the façade (OSM way 192183185): where the hand-built map's origin falls when its façade line (z = -21.6) sits on the real one

rotNote: the façade runs at a bearing of 89.1° (OSM way 192183185): turned 0.9° clockwise it lies along the game's x axis, the steps straight up the screen

plan.note: the whole real site: the old nave behind the façade to the north, the forecourt down to Rua de São Paulo to the south
